fields.narration: All hands, this is the facilitator. It is now 18:30. Field crews have completed manual verification across Pressure District 7. RS-21 and RS-22 are confirmed at 13.2 in. w.c. on field gauges, with pressure still rising. PR-7B now reads 15.4 in. w.c. and shows no sign of stabilization. The control room remains isolated from remote access. The shift cannot wait for verification—life safety is at risk.
